newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CBR sees 1997 results on par with 1996.
newsitem.headline: CBR sees 1997 results on par with 1996.

text.p: Belgian cement maker CBR said on Wednesday it expected 1997 results to be only on a par with those it achieved in calendar 1996 when it reported group net profits up 12.6 percent at 4.4 billion francs.

Chairman Donald Fallon told the company's annual meeting he expected much stronger construction activity in North America and Turkey which would offset the expected stagnation in western European markets and add to the slight rise in Central Europe.
"On the basis of these forecasts and the business trends... we can say today that our results for 1997 should be comparable to those achieved in 1996," he said.
